title.zh: ChatGPT 桌面应用更新：Plus 可用 Space，Codex Remote 更稳
title.en: ChatGPT desktop update: Spaces for Plus, and more reliable Codex Remote

summary.zh: 11 月 20 日，ChatGPT 桌面应用的 Anthony Ambrosino 宣布了一轮更新：Plus 也可以用 Space、全应用更简单的视觉设计、性能改进、重做的线程、重新设计的 Space 首页、更快的 Pages 和 Slides、移动端可编辑 Pages，以及更可靠的 Codex Remote。这条进展在 11 月 20 日和 21 日的日报里没有单独成篇，11 月 23 日的日报才报道，因此 reported_on 是 2026-11-23，happened_at 按官方宣布日写作 2026-11-20。同日 Codex 团队征求升级后仍需修的体验缺口，那是收口讨论，不是又一次发版，不另立事件。
summary.en: On 20 November, ChatGPT desktop's Anthony Ambrosino announced an update: Spaces for Plus, a simpler visual design across the app, performance work, reworked threads, a redesigned Spaces home, faster Pages and Slides, editable Pages on mobile, and more reliable Codex Remote. The 20 and 21 November digests did not cover it as a standalone item; the 23 November digest did, so reported_on is 2026-11-23 and happened_at is 2026-11-20, the announcement day. A same-day Codex request for leftover upgrade gaps is follow-up discussion, not another release, and does not get its own leaf.

brief.zh: ChatGPT 桌面应用宣布 Plus 可用 Space，并改进线程、Pages、Slides 与移动端编辑，同时称 Codex Remote 更可靠。
brief.en: The ChatGPT desktop app announced Spaces for Plus, plus work on threads, Pages, Slides, and mobile editing, and said Codex Remote is more reliable.

why.zh: 这是官方桌面客户端更新，覆盖 ChatGPT 与 Codex Remote，应记在首次被日报报道的那天，并用宣布日填写发生日。
why.en: An official desktop-client update covering ChatGPT and Codex Remote. Place it on the first digest that reported it, and use the announcement day as happened_at.

label.zh: Anthony Ambrosino 宣布桌面更新
label.en: Anthony Ambrosino announces the desktop update
